dar_1948_reading: Ida Lee Costello  Mar.   , 1931  at 63 yrs. 29 ds.
assessment: Born c.Feb 1868. No Ida Costello in the data; the Costellos present are Benjamin Jasper (1869-1937) and Kathleen L. (1926-1996). Candidate lost stone.

dar_1948_reading: Susan Carter d. Oct. 19, 1867 at 8 yrs.
assessment: LV0206 Edward F. Carter (1857 - 19 Oct 1865) is 'S/O SUSAN CARTER' and would have been 8 years old. Same day, same month, same age. Almost certainly ONE stone read two different ways 78 years apart - the DAR taking the mother's name as the decedent's, or the modern reading taking the son's. The year also differs, 1867 vs 1865. Needs the stone itself.

Not a name - the surveyors recorded the FACT of an unmarked burial in the Cox lot in 1948. This is a documented unmarked grave and belongs in any unmarked-graves tally. The Cox lot holds LV0267-LV0270.

dar_1948_reading: Ellem McDaniel  Apr. 1, 1934 - 58 yrs. 11 mos. 14 ds.
assessment: Born c.17 Apr 1875. No Ellem/Ellen McDaniel in the data; nearest are Fannie P. (1869-1936) and Helen Moatz McDaniel (1896-1944). Candidate lost stone. Note 'Ellem' may be a typescript error for Ellen.
NO person of the surname Field appears anywhere in the Lakeview data. The strongest lost-stone candidate of the set - an entire surname present in 1948 and absent now.

dar_1948_reading: Maggie J. Graham, b. May 25, 1871 d. July 27, 1943
assessment: LV0470 Maggie J Graham is 1856-05-25 to 1916-01-28. Same name, same day and month of birth, but fifteen years apart and a death date 27 years apart. Either two women of the same name or two badly conflicting records. Do not merge.
